## How to Sign This CLA on a Pull Request

To sign this CLA on any Pull Request, post the following exact comment on your Pull Request:

> `I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA`

Or, if using the **CLA Assistant (`cla-assistant.io`)** badge on the Pull Request, click **"Sign the CLA"** with your GitHub account.
